checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GDVec n)),
  (∀ (m : ℕ) (A : Set (GDVec m)),
      0 ≤ dimH A ∧
        ∀ (s : ℝ),
          0 < s →
            GDMeasure s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A ∧
              (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → GDMeasure s A = ∞) ∧
                (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → GDMeasure s A = 0) ∧
                  (GDMeasure s A < ∞ → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧
                    (GDMeasure s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧ (GDMeasure s A = ∞ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A)) →
    (Isometry GDLine ∧
        Function.Bijective GDLine ∧
          ∀ (A : Set ℝ),
            dimH (GDLine '' A) = dimH A ∧
              (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → GDContent s δ (GDLine '' A) = GDContent s δ A) ∧
                ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → GDMeasure s (GDLine '' A) = GDMeasure s A) →
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (t : (N : ℕ) → Fin (N + 1) → Set (GDVec 1)),
        Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
          (∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)), Metric.ediam (t N i) ≤ r N) →
            (∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, GDLine '' GDInterval ⊆ ⋃ i, t N i) →
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a) (GDLine '' GDInterval) ≤
                Filter.liminf (fun N => ∑ i, Metric.ediam (t N i) ^ a) Filter.atTop
